topic: Edge removal impact test by road class
idea: Remove three main streets of different density levels and measure effect: the lower the original density of the removed edge, the smaller the impact; in heavy traffic removing a road may even reduce density on main streets by diverting flow.
does: Run a closure experiment over several candidate roads and rank them by delay impact.
inputs: list of roads (or top-N by flow), seeds
outputs: table of KPI change per closed road with significance
notes: ACMS critical_links is static; a simulated closure sweep would give dynamic criticality. Reported effects are tiny (1-3%) with no variance, which paired seeds would test.
